{"code": "from IPython.display import display

# Filter for CONTROL-arm patients with MODERATE severity
control_moderate = df[(df['arm'] == 'control') & (df['severity'] == 'moderate')]

# Check the size of the population
total_control_moderate = len(control_moderate)

# Count how many responded
responded_count = control_moderate['responded'].sum()

# Compute the fraction
fraction_responded = responded_count / total_control_moderate

# Print results
display(control_moderate.head())
print(f"Total CONTROL-arm, MODERATE severity patients: {total_control_moderate}")
print(f"Number who responded: {responded_count}")
print(f"Fraction responded: {fraction_responded}")"}
